next_actions: Verify each prospect's current operation, official website, territory and partnership contact.
Deduplicate parent networks, local stations and affiliate stations.
Prioritize Africa, then diaspora markets and regional language corridors.
Prepare separate TV-network, radio-station and hybrid-broadcaster invitation packs.
Send invitations only through verified official contact channels and record message evidence.
Negotiate programme exchange, simulcast, syndication, co-production and distribution separately.
Execute written rights, territory and revenue terms before carriage or rebroadcast.
